name: audio-device
title: Set Audio Device
description: Switch the active audio device of your mac.
author: benvp

commands.name: set-output-device
commands.title: Set Output Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Sets the active audio output device.

commands.name: set-input-device
commands.title: Set Input Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Sets the active audio input device.

commands.name: favourite
commands.title: Set Output Device to Favourite
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Sets the active audio output device to the favourite specified in the preferences

commands.name: toggle-favourites
commands.title: Toggle Favourites
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Toggle the active audio output device between the favourites specified in the preferences

commands.name: list-devices
commands.title: List Devices
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: List all available input and output audio devices

commands.name: priority-monitor
commands.title: Priority Monitor
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Monitor audio devices and automatically switch to highest priority when enabled

preferences.name: monitorInterval
preferences.title: Background Monitoring Interval
preferences.description: How often to check for audio device changes in the background. Lower values are more responsive but use more system resources.

commands.name: priority-refresh
commands.title: Refresh Priority Monitor
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Manually trigger an immediate check and switch to highest priority audio devices

commands.name: use-combo1
commands.title: Use Combo 1
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Switch to the first input/output device combination

preferences.name: comboName
preferences.title: Combo Name
preferences.description: A friendly name for this device combination

preferences.name: input
preferences.title: Input Device
preferences.description: The name of the input device for this combo

preferences.name: output
preferences.title: Output Device
preferences.description: The name of the output device for this combo

commands.name: use-combo2
commands.title: Use Combo 2
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Switch to the second input/output device combination

preferences.name: comboName
preferences.title: Combo Name
preferences.description: A friendly name for this device combination

preferences.name: input
preferences.title: Input Device
preferences.description: The name of the input device for this combo

preferences.name: output
preferences.title: Output Device
preferences.description: The name of the output device for this combo

commands.name: use-combo3
commands.title: Use Combo 3
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Switch to the third input/output device combination

preferences.name: comboName
preferences.title: Combo Name
preferences.description: A friendly name for this device combination

preferences.name: input
preferences.title: Input Device
preferences.description: The name of the input device for this combo

preferences.name: output
preferences.title: Output Device
preferences.description: The name of the output device for this combo

preferences.name: systemOutput
preferences.title: Play sound effects through current output
preferences.description: Play system sounds through current output.
preferences.label: Update system sounds output

preferences.name: favourite
preferences.title: Favourite Output Device
preferences.description: The name, as found in the output device list, of the output device to use as the first favourite

preferences.name: favourite2
preferences.title: Favourite Output Device 2
preferences.description: The name, as found in the output device list, of the output device to use as the second favourite

preferences.name: enableAutoSwitch
preferences.title: Enable Automatic Priority Switching
preferences.description: Automatically switch to the highest priority available device when audio devices connect or disconnect. Use 'Refresh Priority Monitor' command for immediate manual switching.
preferences.label: Enable automatic switching

scripts.build: npm run copy-binary && ray build -e dist
